document.name: Smart Sofa with Wrought Iron Base and ESP32
document.description: A full-scale 2.1-meter smart three-seater sofa built on a welded tubular wrought iron frame, integrated with an ESP32-WROOM-32 controller, capacitive occupancy sensors, underglow ambient lighting, and an armrest control hub.
document.provenance: AI generated conceptual assembly. Geometry, dimensions and specifications are illustrative; no CAD fit, wiring or hardware operation has been verified.

parts.name: Wrought Iron Base Frame

parts.role: Welded 45mm square tubular iron perimeter frame with six heavy-duty legs, crossbeams, and protective floor pads.

steps.title: Weld and Level the Wrought Iron Base
steps.description: Assemble the 2.1-meter tubular wrought iron perimeter frame, six legs with floor glides, and bolt on the rear and side upright stanchions.

steps.title: Install Slat Suspension and Under-Seat Electronics Tray
steps.description: Fasten the twelve spring-steel suspension slats across the iron rails and mount the ventilated steel electronics tray between the center crossbeams.

steps.title: Mount ESP32 Controller, Power Supply, and Underglow Bar
steps.description: Secure the ESP32-WROOM-32 carrier board and 24V/5V power supply inside the tray, then clip the addressable RGBW LED diffuser bar under the front iron rail.

steps.title: Fit Upholstered Deck and Capacitive Occupancy Mats
steps.description: Place the upholstered plinth deck over the slats and lay the three capacitive foil occupancy mats across the left, center, and right seating zones, routing their ribbons to the ESP32.

steps.title: Attach Armrests and Smart Control Console
steps.description: Bolt the left armrest and right walnut-inlaid smart armrest onto the side stanchions, then connect the flush Qi charger, USB-C PD ports, and I2C touch panel to the internal harness.

steps.title: Install Backrest Shell and Cushions
steps.description: Slide the upholstered backrest shell over the rear iron uprights and arrange the three high-resilience seat cushions and three tufted back cushions.

conversation.text: I have designed a full-scale 2.1-meter Smart Three-Seater Sofa built on a welded tubular wrought iron base and powered by an ESP32-WROOM-32 controller. The iron chassis supports a spring-steel slat deck and a recessed under-seat electronics tray housing the ESP32 carrier board and dual-rail 24V/5V power supply. Three capacitive occupancy sensor mats sit beneath the seat cushions, an addressable RGBW underglow diffuser bar runs along the front iron rail, and the right armrest integrates a walnut console with a 15W Qi wireless charger, USB-C PD ports, and I2C capacitive scene buttons.
